findings.title: Accepted self-disable behavior conflicts with explicit empty field denials
evidence: target.rs:2391 enumerates restrictions for all CRUD even empty field policies
target.rs:5118-5150 builds changed_fields from fixed transition assignments plus generated change time
target.rs:5199-5294 passes those fields through both SQL mutation scope and row policy write checks
User.status and User.disabled_at declare policy {}; User.disable_user alone declares self update exception
golden-todo-routes.test.ts:397 independently expected 204 but received 404 with copied hash-pinned compiler
findings.assessment: The explicit-denial implementation is consistent with field default-deny; the failing existing positive test proves behavioral incompatibility, not by itself permission to bypass or rewrite field policy. DATA-007 preserves intended self-disable but says a transition grants no authority. POLICY-D15/D19/D30 and section 7.1 make field policy and ownership independent conjunctive gates. No explicit accepted self:update grant for these two fields was found in the reviewed current frozen matrix/contracts.
findings.recommendation: Do not bypass field policy merely because SQL assignments are compiler-owned lifecycle writes. Request explicit human approval for a narrow compatibility grant UserRole.self:[update] on User.status and User.disabled_at, with no read/create/delete additions and no base User update grant. Exact User.disable_user named-operation authority remains required. Ordinary set/patch of lifecycle-owned fields remains compiler-rejected.
findings.acceptedAuthorityEvidenceLimit: DATA-007 lines 92-105 and RM-106 checkpoint lines 307-314 establish accepted self-disable observable behavior and its exact named logical update, but do not explicitly approve changing empty field policies. That is intent evidence, not a fabricated approval of the exact field matrix edit. Do not silently alter the frozen golden policy.
findings.earlierRecommendationCorrection: Reviewer initially suggested treating fixed lifecycle assignments separately from ordinary field gates. After reading the explicit section 7.1 conjunction and D30, that bypass recommendation was withdrawn. Preserve this correction; the final recommendation is approval-gated field-matrix reconciliation.

SQL/row entity operation check AND field check; denied mixed supplied/fixed fields perform no commit. Empty/read-only restrictions include absent effects. Each generated callable supplies its own qualified operation key and retains principal. No callee borrowing was observed; this is not exhaustive approval of every wrapper/graph.

This proves the simple one-resource-scope composition, not live reminder eligibility.
Replacing service receipt projection with owner-only title projection is rejected POLICY_OUTPUT_FIELD_UNPROVED; no silent field removal or broad service projection.
